arguments.command:
cd /workspace/tmp && cat > timeit.py <<'EOF'
import subprocess, time, sys, resource, os
f=sys.argv[1]
t0=time.time()
before=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
p=subprocess.run(['/workspace/submission/run.sh'], stdin=open(f,'rb'), stdout=open('/workspace/tmp/timeout.json','wb'))
after=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
print('wall %.2fs user %.2fs sys %.2fs' % (time.time()-t0, after.ru_utime-before.ru_utime, after.ru_stime-before.ru_stime))
EOF
for mf in 0 1 3 7 14; do echo -n "maxf=$mf: "; python3 timeit.py bm$mf.json; head -c 90 timeout.json; echo; done
